scope: source-distribution diagnosis on existing training/validation cohorts; no generation or classifier input

definitions.speed: One-second increments of interpolated cumulative native coordinate arc length; bins cover [0,floor(observed span)].
definitions.longest_steady_s: Longest true run of (v[1:]>=.3)&(abs(diff(v))<.5), following G23/G28. A constant N-second speed series has N-1 stable transitions.
definitions.duration_s: Observed continuous-segment span, including any fractional final second; not declared full journey duration.
definitions.mean_absolute_lag4_speed_change_mps: Mean abs(v[t+4]-v[t]); not divided by four.
definitions.mean_absolute_acceleration_mps2: Mean absolute difference of one-second speed bins, divided by one second.
definitions.stopped_fraction: Fraction of one-second speed bins below .3 m/s.
definitions.longest_stop_s: Longest contiguous run of bins below .3 m/s.
definitions.stop_episodes_per_minute: Number of stopped runs (including a left-censored first run) *60 / number of whole-second speed bins.
definitions.arc_length_m: Native coordinate arc length over the entire continuous segment, including a fractional final second.
definitions.feature_scope: The first seven features reproduce G23 phys/G28 physical; all are scalar trajectory-level distributions.

native_speed_consistency.definition: per-track coordinate versus trapezoid-integrated native speed, identical one-second bins
native_speed_consistency.interpretation: includes rounding, chord geometry and integration effects; not a pure coordinate quantization estimate
native_speed_consistency.reason: raw cohort does not contain an aligned native_speed field; no substitute clock or source is used

difference_direction: negative means native MoST demand is closer to CNR for that metric; no sum across different physical units

bootstrap.unit: one union base entity across source domains
bootstrap.draw: independent Exp(1) weight per union entity; shared CNR/native identity has the same weight
bootstrap.normalization: weights separately normalized within each source and class
bootstrap.reference: same CNR weights reused for native and random comparisons
bootstrap.sources: CNR uses original IDs, native uses base_ids; random SUMO IDs are domain-prefixed to prevent accidental identity matching
bootstrap.macro: equal mean across all six classes within one physical metric; absent if any class unsupported
bootstrap.limits: Bayesian-bootstrap credible intervals, not frequency-guaranteed confidence intervals; conditional on observed demand templates and a few simulation seeds, not new episodes/lines/maps; no multiple-comparison adjustment
